summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new Inter-Plant Stock Transfer (STO) feature. Backend: 29 pytest tests created in /app/backend/tests/test_stock_transfer.py covering auth gating (401 without vms_session, 'inventory' page permission works, /api/products/search widened), inventory lookup, ship-to-sites company filtering (P9 -> P2/P2W/P3/P4/P7, never P1/P8; P1 -> P8 only), per-site dynamic locations, deterministic suggest-source ranking + ship-to exclusion, order creation success + persistence + no _id leakage + incrementing STO IDs, and the full 400-validation matrix (insufficient stock, zero/negative qty, past/missing date, no items, cross-company ship-to, same-site ship-to, unknown ship-to location, cross-site multi-item, warehouse-without-stock, missing source warehouse), plus 2 live LLM parse-nl tests. ALL 29 PASS. Frontend: 5 Playwright runs covering nav dropdown entry, page load/read-only fields, product search+add+duplicate toast, AI suggestion (suggest-only, click-to-apply), exact insufficient-stock inline error, ship-to site/location cascading dropdowns, blocked-create validations, full valid create (STO-000009, 'Pending SAP' badge, form reset), remove-item, cross-site multi-item blocking, and the AI Quick Entry parse -> preview -> Apply to Form flow. One real state bug found (stale Ship-to Site/Location after removing all line items). Everything else worked as specified.

ui_bugs.issue: Removing the line item that derived Ship-from Site does NOT reset shipToSiteId/shipToLocationId state. Repro: add 100002693-C1 (P9) -> apply suggestion -> Ship-to Site P4 -> Ship-to Location 'FINISH GOODS GODOWN-P4' -> trash the row -> add 1124-274 (site P1, different Company). Result: Ship-to Site trigger renders EMPTY (stale value 'P4' has no matching option) while Ship-to Location still visibly shows 'FINISH GOODS GODOWN-P4' (a P4 warehouse under a P1 ship-from). Frontend validation passes it through and only the backend rejects with 'Ship-to Site P4 does not belong to the same Company as Ship-from Site P1.' Fix: clear shipToSiteId/shipToLocationId (and formError) whenever shipFromSiteId becomes '' or changes.

ui_bugs.component: StockTransferPage - warehouse Select for a 2nd item at another site
ui_bugs.issue: Minor UX: once Ship-from Site is derived, a second item that only has stock at a different site shows an EMPTY warehouse dropdown with placeholder 'Choose warehouse' (no explanatory empty-state), yet its AI 'Suggested: P2 / RAW MATERIAL GODOWN-P2' link is still clickable and DOES set a mismatched site - reaching the 'All line items must ship from the same Ship-from Site' error only at Create time. Consider hiding/greying the cross-site suggestion or showing 'No stock at P9 for this item - create a separate STO' in the empty dropdown.

issues: Layout, spacing, contrast, table borders and badge colours all fine at 1920x1080; native date input is intentional per spec (min=2026-08-24 enforced).

Console noise (not this feature): GET /api/bom/connection-status returns 403 for an 'inventory'-only user, so the header SapConnectionStatus badge always reads 'SAP Disconnected' for such users - pre-existing/unrelated, flagged for awareness only.

action_items: Reset shipToSiteId + shipToLocationId when shipFromSiteId clears/changes (removeItem or a useEffect on shipFromSiteId) so no stale cross-site Ship-to Location is displayed or submitted.
Optional: give the source-warehouse Select an explicit empty-state and suppress the cross-site AI suggestion for items with no stock at the derived Ship-from Site.
critical_code_review_comments: StockTransferPage.js: shipFromSiteId is derived (items.find(...)), but shipToSiteId/shipToLocationId are independent state with no invalidation on ship-from change - the source of the stale-state bug above.

applyNlPreview() uses setTimeout(300ms) to write the parsed quantity into the last line item; this is a race (if the /stock-transfer/inventory call is slower the qty write can land on the wrong/absent row). Prefer setting requested_qty inside addItem's state update (e.g. pass an initialQty argument).
Backend validation is correctly duplicated server-side (defense in depth) and all error strings match the spec verbatim; no _id leakage in /api/stock-transfer/orders responses. No issues.

Nav requires clicking data-testid='nav-inventory' first, then 'nav-inventory-stock-transfer' (hover does not open the dropdown). Line-item row testids are prefixed 'stock-transfer-line-' which also matches -items-card/-items-table, so use the exact product-suffixed testid when counting rows. Backend suite: pytest tests/test_stock_transfer.py (runs under xdist; the session helper is worker-scoped). Only outstanding defect is the stale Ship-to Site/Location state after removing all line items.
rca_of_the_issue: shipFromSiteId is a derived value from the items array, while shipToSiteId/shipToLocationId are separate useState values. Removing the last line item recomputes shipFromSiteId to '' and clears shipToSiteOptions, but never clears the stored shipToSiteId/shipToLocationId; a Radix Select with a value that has no matching SelectItem renders an empty trigger, so the stale Ship-to Site is invisible while the Ship-to Location (whose options list is still the old site's) keeps rendering the old warehouse. Frontend runValidation() then sees both fields as truthy and posts them; only the backend's company check blocks it (correctly, HTTP 400 - no bad order was created).
